notes:
The room movements panel is now three lists — ARRIVALS, DEPARTURES, MOVES — with no turnover group: a room that departed and was arrived into is on both. A move reads old room → new room, in cyan.

The dot on a departure or move, and the red LEAVING TODAY mark, now take a receipt whose name is the opening of the departing guest's name — the report cuts names at the column, protel does not — unless another name protel shows for that room opens the same way, in which case nothing is marked. The arriving guest's paper is never marked.

When protel's in-house list is captured while the department check is open, the names on the rows and the search cards refresh in place. The cards and rows show the whole name, wrapped, never cut with an ellipsis.
